notes: imd/acc Sepolia test run 4, the fourth and last before mainnet, from the launch-sepolia branch: one contract, the ProjectRegistry, the list of projects whose sIMD cashback (0.25% to 1% of each trade, at the project's choice) earns points, decided by IdentityMD oracle panels through Intake v2 (0xa43e...de82, paid in the Sepolia test IMD 0x44a1...f89a). It is test run 3's registry (launch #1371, 0x9b46...fc2d) plus the fix for that launch's judged low: a bond the oracle asset refuses to pay no longer holds a question open. It is the code the mainnet registry will use, with Sepolia settings, and asks the panel with the 8 rules of version 2 (docs/panel-rules-v2.md), each under 512 characters. Constructor: (intake, oracleAsset, stacker, oracleSigner, questionChainId 1, challengeBond 5e18, challengeCooldown 3600). It is wired to test run 2's live Stacker 0x0457...314d (launch #1294), which is not redeployed and no TestIMD or TestSIMD is deployed either: that Stacker runs src/Stacker.sol byte for byte on the live TestIMD 0x2b69...1e82 and TestSIMD 0xf9e2...1cc1 of launch #1129 (test/SepoliaFork.t.sol checks it), and PLEA's hook already credits through it; the registry only names the Stacker in its questions and never calls it. Anyone calls applyListing(project, name, sourceUrl, rateBps 25-100, beneficiary) or, for a listed project, challengeForBeneficiary(project, reason, beneficiary), paying the oracle fee read live from the Intake (ORACLE_FEE(), 0.5 test IMD, which anyone can mint) plus the 5 test-IMD bond for a challenge; the registry asks one yes-or-no question with requestWithFailure. onOracleResult accepts only the Intake, only its own open request, each answer once, only a signature by the oracle signer 0x5598...2982 for this contract issued after the ask (300-second tolerance), from a panel of 15 with at least 11 agreeing: yes lists from that block, or keeps a challenged project (bond to its beneficiary, cooldown not restarted); no rejects, or delists from that block (bond back). A challenge asks about the project's current rate within 25-100 bps. onOracleFailure only clears the open question and returns the bond; expire clears one after a day or once the Intake completed it. Paying a bond never blocks these: if the token refuses the transfer, the bond is recorded in bondOwed (BondOwed) and its recipient takes it later with claimBond(to), to any wallet. setBeneficiary waits while a question is open and changes the wallet at most once per day (HANDOFF_INTERVAL, HandoffTooSoon otherwise). Questions are filed under chain 1 because the oracle has no Sepolia RPC, and name Sepolia in their text. No owner; the constructor makes no external call, so it also runs on the empty rehearsal chain. Runtime 22,736 bytes; about 35.9M gas to deploy on Sepolia's current schedule (read 2026-10-12, block 11,897,397; Intake v2 callback gas 1,000,000). Test doubles under test/mocks and test/trial are not deployed. Once live, the address goes into the README Deployments table as Sepolia test run 4.
